integrity: Standalone proof, explicit parameter assumptions and exact-integer finite verifier supplied. Central-trinomial coefficients are classical; novelty claim is their core-election application.
scientific_limitations: The theorem applies only to one-to-one cyclic adjacent-pair approvals and the strict Hare core with \(2k\le n\); the \(k>n/2\) regime, other quotas, heterogeneous weights, and generic profiles are not characterized. Finite tests are supportive, not a substitute for the proof. Priority overlap in unindexed literature is possible.
title: The half-budget Hare-core threshold and central-trinomial census for cyclic two-approval elections
